The setup packet preserves Example Services LLC and Example Services Holdings LLC as conflicting records. The S2 invoice-routing scope includes employee names, so Privacy P1 for S1 is reopened.
Give Procurement, Privacy and Finance precise requests. Keep payment details out of the packet.

I prepared the minimized setup fields, five-item checklist and three exact owner questions. Finance is asked only for a controlled receipt after entity resolution; no bank details are requested. This remains a private review draft, not activation or verified payment setup.

report.title: Supplier SUP-17 setup packet
report.summary: Private packet R1 for BUY-US under ONB-3. Five checklist items are represented. Entity, Privacy and Finance prerequisites remain unresolved; no supplier activation or contact performed.

items.title: Setup fields
items.summary: SUP-17 / BUY-US. Service: invoice routing including employee names, scope S2. Selection supplied by Business owner; not activation authority.

items.title: Entity conflict
items.summary: Intake I2 names Example Services LLC; contract C1 names Example Services Holdings LLC. Procurement owner must supply authoritative corrected records, scoped resolution and any master-match observation. Neither name silently wins.

items.title: Privacy reopened
items.summary: P1 covered Example Services LLC under S1 without personal data. Its date validity does not cover S2. Privacy owner must review the resolved entity and exact current scope.

items.title: Finance evidence missing
items.summary: Finance owner must provide only a controlled verification receipt reference bound to the resolved entity and S2 scope. No bank account, tax identifier or credential belongs in this packet.

items.title: Private handoff
items.summary: Procurement owner delivers the actual packet, checklist and exact questions to Supplier activation owner. Selection, specialist judgment, payment verification and activation remain separate human decisions.
